SELECT mpp.id,
m.id AS authorId, m.nickname AS authorNickname, m.profile_image AS authorProfileImage,
mpp.missing_date AS missingDate, mpp.missing_address AS missingAddress, mpp.detail, mpp.image_url AS imageUrl, mpp.status,
mpp.latitude, mpp.longitude,
mpp.created_at AS createdAt, mpp.updated_at AS updatedAt
FROM missing_pet_post mpp
JOIN member m ON mpp.member_id = m.id
WHERE mpp.id = #{id}

SELECT mpr.id,
m.id AS reporterId, m.nickname AS reporterNickname, m.profile_image AS reporterProfileImage,
mpr.address, mpr.detail, mpr.image_url AS imageUrl,
mpr.sight_at AS sightAt,
mpr.latitude, mpr.longitude,
mpr.created_at AS createdAt
FROM missing_pet_report mpr
JOIN member m ON mpr.member_id = m.id
WHERE mpr.missing_pet_post_id = #{missingPetPostId}
ORDER BY mpr.created_at DESC
